chunks: And your Lord creates what He wills and chooses. The choice is not for them. Exalted is Allah and high above what they associate [with Him].
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah creates what He wills and chooses?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia exegesis to highlight divine omnipotence, underscores that Allah's creative will is absolute and independent of human preference, contrasting His sovereign choice (Ikhtiyar) with the contingent nature of creation. It serves as a theological refutation of polytheism by affirming Allah's transcendence (Tanzih) above any partners, reinforcing the concept of Tawhid in both essence and action.
